transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um… I think my work sort of wanted me to come. It’s not like I was trying to cause problems or anything. I work at a warehouse, and sometimes I guess I get… stuck doing things.

Like I’ll be by the forklift and just freeze with my arms up, or I might copy the beeping sounds or the hand signals. And I’ve moved boxes around in little patterns, even when people are telling me to stop. I know that probably sounds bad. I’m not trying to be difficult.
When someone makes a hand signal near you, do you find yourself copying it automatically even when you do not want to?

Yeah… sometimes. I don’t mean to, it just sort of happens before I think about it. Like if someone does a hand signal near the forklift, my hands might do it too, and then I realize people are looking at me.

I’m not trying to mock anybody or mess around. It’s just… I get stuck in it, I guess. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
When you freeze like that, do you sometimes become unable to speak?

Sometimes, yeah… I mean, not like I’m trying to ignore people. I just kind of lock up. Like by the forklift, my arms will be up, and people are saying my name or telling me to move, and I can’t really get the words out right away.

It’s embarrassing. I know it probably looks strange, especially with the copying sounds or signals and the boxes and all that. I’m not trying to make trouble. I just… get stuck. Is that okay to say?
When these freezing episodes happen, do you remember them clearly afterward?

I… I remember parts of it, yeah. Mostly I remember people yelling for me to stop, or realizing my arms were still up by the forklift, or that I’d been copying the beeps or the hand signals again.

It’s a little blurry sometimes, not like I’m doing it on purpose. Afterward I can tell I moved the boxes into those little patterns, and I feel bad because everyone’s upset. I know it sounds strange. I’m trying to answer that right.
During these times, have you felt unusually energized and needed much less sleep than usual?

Um… I don’t think so. Not like energized, no.

I might sleep badly sometimes, but during those times I don’t feel like I’ve got extra energy or anything. It’s more like I’m just stuck or worn out afterward. If that makes sense?
Since you were a child, have you usually had a hard time understanding social cues or making friends?

I don’t know… I mean, I had some friends growing up. I wasn’t, like, the most popular or anything, but I don’t think it was a big problem.

Social cues… I’m not totally sure what counts. Sometimes I might miss stuff, but I thought that was normal. I don’t want to make it sound like there was some big lifelong issue if there wasn’t. Is that what you mean?
Have you ever had a seizure?

I don’t think so, no. I mean, nobody’s ever told me I had one, and I haven’t been diagnosed with that or anything.

Unless you mean those times where I kind of freeze up… but I don’t know if that counts. I don’t want to say the wrong thing.
When you freeze, can someone gently guide your body to move again?

Um… sometimes, yeah, I think if someone kind of tells me what to do or moves me away, I’ll go along with it. I’m not trying to be difficult.

Like at the warehouse, I guess that’s why they brought me in… I freeze up with my arms up near the forklift, or I’ll start copying the beeping noises or the hand signals. And sometimes I move the boxes in these little patterns that probably don’t make sense to everyone else, even when people are yelling at me to stop.

I know that sounds bad. I don’t mean to cause problems.
Do you ever hear voices when no one is there?

Um… I don’t think so. Not, like, a voice standing in the room or anything.

Sometimes I’m not totally sure if it’s just my own thoughts being loud, if that makes sense. But I haven’t really noticed hearing someone talking when nobody’s there. Is that… is that the kind of thing you mean?
Has a doctor ever told you that you have a brain or nerve condition?

No, I don’t think so. Nobody’s told me I have anything like that, at least not that I remember.

I mean, I’ve been asked questions before, but I don’t have, like, a diagnosis for a brain or nerve thing. Is that what you mean?
Have you been feeling sure that people are trying to harm you or are plotting against you?

I don’t think so… not like I’m sure people are plotting against me.

I mean, I get uncomfortable sometimes and maybe I worry people are mad at me, but I wouldn’t want to say they’re trying to harm me if that’s not true. I don’t think I have proof of anything like that. Is that an okay answer?
Have people told you that you seem emotionally flat or not show much feeling?

I’m not really sure… I don’t think anyone’s said it to me directly, like, “you’re emotionally flat.”

Maybe people have said I seem quiet or hard to read sometimes, but I don’t know if that’s the same thing. I’m not trying to be cold or anything. Does that answer it okay?
Do people ever have trouble understanding you because your speech becomes hard to follow or jumps from one idea to another?

Maybe sometimes, yeah… I don’t mean to, though.

At work, if my supervisor asks which pallets are supposed to go on the truck, I’ll start explaining from the load sheet, and then somehow I’m talking about my old house, or fishing, or the church boxes, and I can see people looking confused. By the end, they don’t really know what I meant.

I know that probably sounds bad. I’m trying to answer straight. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Do you have beliefs that other people find strange or hard to understand, even though they feel completely real to you?

I don’t know… I don’t think I have anything like that, not really.

I mean, sometimes I might say something and people don’t get what I mean, but I wouldn’t say I have beliefs that are strange or completely real in that way. At least I don’t think so.

Maybe I’m not understanding the question exactly. Is that an okay answer?
Did these freezing and copying episodes start after you began using any new medication or drugs?

I don’t think it was from anything new like that… at least, I don’t know of anything.

They brought me in more because of what I was doing at the warehouse, I guess. I would sort of freeze by the forklift with my arms up, or copy the beeping sounds and people’s hand signals, and sometimes I’d move boxes in these little patterns even when people were telling me to stop.

I know that probably sounds weird. I wasn’t trying to cause trouble. Does that answer what you mean?
Have these episodes ever happened when you were confused or had a fever?

I’m not really sure… I don’t remember having a fever with it or anything like that.

Confused, maybe people would say I looked confused, but I don’t know if I felt sick-confused, like from a fever. I don’t want to answer wrong. I just don’t think there was anything like that going on, as far as I know.
Outside of those freezing episodes, have you had long periods where you felt very little emotion or had trouble finding the motivation to do everyday things?

I’m not sure… I mean, I don’t think I’d call it long periods exactly.

Sometimes I’m probably quieter or I don’t get things done as fast as I should, but I figured that was just being tired or not having a good day. I don’t really think of myself as having no emotion or anything. 

Maybe I’m not noticing what you mean, though. Is that the kind of thing you’re asking about?
Do you ever feel like an outside force is controlling your body or making you move?

I don’t know… I don’t think I’d say it like that, like an outside force.

Sometimes it probably looks like I’m not fully deciding what I’m doing, but I haven’t really thought of it as someone controlling my body. Maybe I’m not explaining it right. What do you mean by outside force exactly?
Have you ever had a head injury?
Not that I know of. I mean, I’ve bumped my head before like anybody, but I don’t think I’ve ever had a real head injury or anything serious. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Do these freezing or copying episodes tend to happen when you are under stress?

Maybe… yeah, probably more when things are busy or people are watching me.

At the warehouse, that’s kind of why they brought me in, I think. I’ll freeze up by the forklift with my arms kind of stuck, or I’ll start copying the beeping sounds or the hand signals. Sometimes I move boxes in these little patterns instead of just doing it the normal way, even if people are telling me to stop.

I don’t mean to cause trouble or anything. It just… happens, especially when everyone’s yelling or things feel intense. Is that what you mean by stress?

final_diagnosis.reason: The presentation is most consistent with catatonic schizophrenia: the patient shows multiple catatonic features including freezing/posturing, mutism during episodes, echophenomena (copying hand signals and beeping sounds), stereotyped/repetitive behavior (arranging boxes in patterns), and apparent automatic obedience/being guidable.
